item.title: Onee-chan to Issho. ~Yuina no Ama Ama Zen Koutei~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Bousaba G
  • 発売日: 2020-10-25
  • スコア: 5.970000000000001/10 (34 人評価)
  • 日本語名: お姉ちゃんといっしょ。～唯奈のあまあま全肯定～
  • 英語名: Onee-chan to Issho. Yuina no Ama Ama Zen Koutei

别名

  • Onee-chan to Issho. Yuina no Ama Ama Zen Koutei

あらすじ

The stress of the daily grind leaves you simply exhausted when you return home.

However, one day, when you come back from work…

“Welcome home!”

That kind voice. It’s your sister Yuina, who’s come to check up on you.
